description: Reads the media of an app: photos, textures, sounds, videos and 3D models (glb), in COLLECTIONS and in an order, each item with a card (title, text, alt and the developer's own fields), apart from the app's files. "collections" → { collections: [{ collection, key, count, bytes }], usage: { scope, used, limit, free } }; "list" { collection, offset?, limit? } → the items in order, each { id, position, title, text, alt, fields, note?, width, height, url, srcset, variants, original, bytes }; "get" { id }. An item may carry "note", never shown to users: what the file is and how client.js uses it. A private item says private: true with unlockedBy. "holders" { id } → who has the right to a file (buyers, live subscribers, who used a credit); "download_link" { id } → a time-limited link for the developer to the file, changing no data. Changes nothing; neblla_media uploads, edits and deletes.
name: neblla_media_read
title: Media (read)
